title: Junk-o-Tron
description:
Help your team of robot co-workers clear the scrap in this fast-paced match-3 game. Good performance unlocks new robots with unique block-stacking patterns and styles. 

Features• Four (4) robots violating their original operating parameters for fun and profit

• 9 accessibility options, including separate music and SFX sliders

• 10 achievements for pro players to show off their skills

• Integrated tutorial to teach you the basics

• Difficulty options and advanced tips for expert players 

• High score list to track your best times and scores

• Playable using only the mouse

• Playable using only the keyboard

• XBox and PlayStation controllers supported via Community Layouts (no UI prompt support)

• Steam Deck supported using either buttons or touchscreen (no UI prompt support)

• Native Linux and Steam Deck support

• Precision cursor option for touchscreens

• Extremely realistic CRT display (note: not very realistic)

• Extremely realistic Einsteinian wormhole physics (note: dangerously realistic)

• Pre-rendered CGI animations will make you check you haven't time traveled back to the 90s

• At least one cheat code

Includes accessibility options for improved visibility and reduced distractions.
description_short: A fast-paced match-3 block puzzle game. The scrapyard is filling up! Help your robot team refine and recycle everything so we can warp it out of here. Hone your skills to clear everything fast and get the maximum score!
